# tamil-toolkit

> Memory-safe Rust Tamil linguistic library (`#![forbid(unsafe_code)]`) with Python (PyO3), TypeScript/WebAssembly (Node.js & Browser), and Dart/Flutter bindings, an offline browser Playground, and a Microsoft Word Add-in. Apache-2.0 licensed, created by Abishtakan Sivachandrathevan and tamil-toolkit contributors.

Source checkout verification: 40,160 active golden vectors across core, normalization, collation, numerals, codec, hyphenation, and transliteration. Published alpha-8 release evidence: 36,161 (default/full) and 36,205 (core) vectors verified per isolated consumer.

## Live Tools (Browser Playground)

- [Tamil Toolkit Playground](https://tamil-toolkit-playground.vercel.app/): Browser-based Tamil workbench processing text locally via WebAssembly.
- [Bamini & Legacy Tamil Font Converter](https://tamil-toolkit-playground.vercel.app/tools/bamini-to-unicode/): Bidirectional conversion for Bamini, TSCII, TAB, TAM, Anjal, Vanavil, LT-TM, Senthamil, Shree-Tam, Softview, and TBO, plus client-side PDF text-layer import in the Playground.
- [Tamil Braille Converter (Bharathi Grade 1)](https://tamil-toolkit-playground.vercel.app/tools/tamil-braille-converter/): Bidirectional Unicode Tamil to Bharathi Tamil Braille Grade 1 (`U+2800..U+28FF`).
- [Tamil99 Keyboard & Transliteration](https://tamil-toolkit-playground.vercel.app/tools/tamil99-keyboard/): ISO 15919, Madras Lexicon, ITRANS, Harvard-Kyoto, Phonetic (Tanglish), Tamil99, Anjal Phonetic, and Suratha Bamini.
- [Tamil Number & Cheque Words](https://tamil-toolkit-playground.vercel.app/tools/tamil-number-to-words/): Tamil Nadu (`TN`) and Sri Lanka (`SL`) number-to-words, currency spellout (`INR`, `LKR`, `SGD`, `MYR`, `USD`, `EUR`, `GBP`, `CAD`), formal words-to-number (ITN), mixed fractions, and traditional numerals.
- [Agara Varisai Tamil Sorter](https://tamil-toolkit-playground.vercel.app/tools/agara-varisai-sorter/): Mei-first `agara-v1` and school `uyirmei-first-v1` alphabetical sorting and sort keys.
- [Tamil Syllabic Hyphenator](https://tamil-toolkit-playground.vercel.app/tools/tamil-hyphenation/): Coda-binding soft hyphens (`\u00AD`), line wrapping, Hunspell `.dic`, and LibreOffice `.oxt`.
- [Tamil Solar Calendar & Panchangam](https://tamil-toolkit-playground.vercel.app/tools/tamil-panchangam/): Bounded Thirukanitham (Drik) and 1962 Vakya civil solar dates, five Panchangam limbs, and TN/SL holiday snapshots.

## Installation (Current Alpha-9 Release)

- [Rust crates.io](https://crates.io/crates/tamil-toolkit): `cargo add tamil-toolkit@=0.1.0-alpha.9`
- [Python PyPI](https://pypi.org/project/tamil-toolkit/): `python -m pip install tamil-toolkit==0.1.0a9`
- [npm ESM/WASM](https://www.npmjs.com/package/tamil-toolkit): `npm install tamil-toolkit@alpha`
- [Microsoft Word Add-in](https://tamil-toolkit-word.vercel.app/support.html): Local-processing Fluent 2 Office.js add-in for Word (Windows, macOS, Web).

## Specifications & Release Evidence

- [README & Recipes](https://github.com/abishtakan/tamil-toolkit/blob/master/README.md): Overview, copy-paste recipes, and capability contracts.
- [Alpha 8 Release Evidence](https://github.com/abishtakan/tamil-toolkit/blob/master/docs/releases/alpha-8.md): Isolated consumer verification and package inventory.
- [Core & Normalization Spec](https://github.com/abishtakan/tamil-toolkit/blob/master/docs/specs/core-v0.1.md): Tailored UAX #29 segmentation, Uyirmei composition, NFC/NFD normalization, and Tholkappiyam phonology.
- [Collation Spec](https://github.com/abishtakan/tamil-toolkit/blob/master/docs/specs/collate-v0.1.md): `agara-v1` and `uyirmei-first-v1` ordering rules.
- [Legacy Codec & Braille Specs](https://github.com/abishtakan/tamil-toolkit/blob/master/docs/specs/codec-phase7-legacy.md): Bounded legacy font profiles and [Bharathi Braille Grade 1](https://github.com/abishtakan/tamil-toolkit/blob/master/docs/specs/codec-braille.md).
- [Numerals Spec](https://github.com/abishtakan/tamil-toolkit/blob/master/docs/specs/numerals-v0.4.md): Bounded TN/SL number words, diaspora currencies, mixed fractions, and formal ITN.
- [Transliteration Spec](https://github.com/abishtakan/tamil-toolkit/blob/master/docs/specs/translit-v0.1.md): Scholarly romanization and offline keyboard input profiles.
- [Hyphenation Spec](https://github.com/abishtakan/tamil-toolkit/blob/master/docs/specs/hyphen-v0.1.md): Coda-binding syllabic hyphenation and DTP exports.
- [License & Third-Party Notices](https://github.com/abishtakan/tamil-toolkit/blob/master/NOTICE): Apache-2.0 for original code; optional Wiktionary dictionary packs are CC-BY-SA-4.0.
